headlines.title: 【A股温度计】市场估值指标统计：估值指标陷入震荡
headlines.summary:
8月11日，巴菲特指数（沪深300市值/GDP）回落至92.48%，结束五日连涨；股债性价比指标——沪深300指数股权风险溢价（ERP）为5.25%，7月以来主要围绕着5.2%波动，处于2024年10月以来波动区间下端，暗示目前股市相对国债收益的优势一般。
--------
注：1、巴菲特指数是通过将股市总市值和GDP来比较，判断目前股市是否高估，通常70-100%为正常估值，低于该区间为低估，高于该区间为高估。
2、沪深300指数风险溢价（ERP）主要对比沪深300收益和国债收益率，统计近10年数据可以发现该指标和股指有明显反

headlines.title_en: 【A-share Thermometer】Market valuation indicator stats: Valuation indicators fluctuate in a range
headlines.summary_en:
On August 11, the Buffett Indicator (CSI 300 market cap/GDP) fell back to 92.48%, ending a five-day winning streak. The equity-bond valuation metric—the CSI 300 equity risk premium (ERP)—stood at 5.25%, hovering around 5.2% since July, at the lower end of the range seen since October 2024, suggesting equities' advantage over government bonds is modest.
--------
Note: 1. The Buffett Indicator compares total stock market cap to GDP to gauge whether the market is overvalued; 70-100% is typically normal, below that is undervalued, above is overvalued.
2. The CSI 300 ERP compares CSI 300 returns to government bond yields; data over the past decade shows a clear inverse relationship with the index.

headlines.title: 央行逆回购再现“零操作”，分析称债市调整多出于止盈需求
headlines.summary: 央行逆回购再现“零操作”。8月11日，央行未开展7天期逆回购操作，当日有465亿元逆回购到期，公开市场实现净回笼465亿元。8月11日，资金面总体平稳，债市则在前期连续走强后震荡回调。受访人士认为，此次逆回购“零操作”主要缘于月初流动性充裕、金融机构融资需求下降。债市调整更多来自收益率快速下行后的止盈需求。随着税期临近、政府债券发行提速，加之超长债交易趋于拥挤，债券市场短期内仍将有所波动。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: PBOC reverse repos show 'zero operations' again; analysts say bond market adjustment mostly driven by profit-taking demand
headlines.summary_en: The PBOC again conducted no reverse repo operations. On August 11, the central bank skipped 7-day reverse repo operations, with 46.5 billion yuan in reverse repos maturing that day, resulting in a net liquidity withdrawal of 46.5 billion yuan from the open market. Funding conditions were broadly stable on August 11, while the bond market corrected after recent consecutive gains. Analysts said the zero operation mainly reflects ample liquidity at the start of the month and reduced financing demand from financial institutions. The bond market adjustment is more driven by profit-taking after yields fell rapidly. With the tax period approaching, faster government bond issuance, and crowded ultra-long bond trading, the bond market is likely to remain volatile in the short term. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title_en: South Korea's new sovereign wealth fund could receive over $700 million in additional funding; no immediate plans to directly invest in Samsung and SK Hynix
headlines.summary_en: Korea's Ministry of Economy and Finance head of the Innovation Growth Office Min Kyung-sup said on August 11 the country expects to deploy 600 billion to 1 trillion won (about $707 million) in new funds next year to a new sovereign wealth fund targeting strategic industries such as AI, with final investment possibly exceeding initial estimates depending on identified targets and their funding needs. In July, the government announced it would establish a "Strategic Industry Investment Account" under the Korea Investment Corporation (KIC), with initial capital of at least 20 trillion won (about 94 billion yuan), targeting AI, semiconductors, data centers, and core overseas supply chain firms, with plans to officially launch the "Korean-style sovereign wealth fund" next year. Min said the fund will also target robotics, energy, batteries, grid infrastructure, nuclear power, space, and quantum technology.

headlines.title: 下半年A股投资图谱浮现：科技为矛、改善为盾，两大核心主线成机构共识
headlines.summary: 进入下半年，A股市场在震荡磨底中加快寻找新的运行主线。多方调研获悉，多家一线机构已形成明确共识：机构资金可依托基本面研究适度左侧布局，普通投资者在右侧信号出现时可进一步提高风险偏好；在配置方向上，应由单一赛道抱团转向科技成长、基本面改善与高股息资产的均衡组合。AI产业趋势延续、政策支持持续加码以及资本市场双向开放提速，将为下半年结构性行情提供支撑，但海外货币政策、地缘局势等不确定因素仍需警惕。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: H2 A-share investment map emerges: Tech as the spear, improvement as the shield—two core mainlines become institutional consensus
headlines.summary_en: Entering the second half of the year, the A-share market is accelerating its search for a new trading theme amid volatile bottoming. Surveys show leading institutions share a clear consensus: institutional funds can make modest left-side allocations based on fundamentals research, while retail investors can raise risk appetite when right-side signals emerge; in terms of allocation, the approach should shift from crowding into a single track to a balanced portfolio of tech growth, fundamental improvements, and high-dividend assets. The continued AI industry trend, stronger policy support, and faster two-way capital market opening will underpin structural opportunities in H2, but risks such as overseas monetary policy and geopolitical tensions warrant vigilance. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 外贸高增助推 人民币对美元汇率创三年半新高
headlines.summary: 【外贸高增助推 人民币对美元汇率创三年半新高】8月10日，在岸人民币对美元收盘报6.7442，较上一交易日上涨59个基点，创2023年2月2日以来新高。当日，人民币对美元中间价报6.7884，调升20个基点，创2023年2月10日以来新高。专家表示：“今年进出口实现高位增长是人民币走强的坚实物质基础；同时，今年PPI实现转正，人民币的适度升值有助于抑制或者减弱输入性通货膨胀压力。”

headlines.title_en: Strong foreign trade growth boosts yuan to a 3.5-year high against the US dollar
headlines.summary_en: [Strong foreign trade lifts yuan to 3.5-year high against dollar] On August 10, the onshore yuan closed at 6.7442 per dollar, up 59 basis points from the previous session, the highest since February 2, 2023. The central parity rate was set at 6.7884, up 20 basis points, the strongest since February 10, 2023. Experts said: "High growth in imports and exports this year provides a solid foundation for the yuan's strength; meanwhile, with the PPI turning positive this year, moderate yuan appreciation helps curb imported inflationary pressures."

headlines.summary_en: [Housing included in big-ticket consumption to unleash domestic demand] With the State Council-approved "15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption" placing housing consumption at the top of durable consumer goods, real estate policy is accelerating its shift toward "balancing risk prevention and consumption promotion." headlines.title: 国投证券：预计全国猪价有望启动旺季反弹
headlines.summary: 国投证券研报称，低价区川渝领涨，近期猪价抬头。7月28日以来，川渝地区猪价企稳回升，截至8月6日的涨幅已分别达0.9元/公斤和0.8元/公斤。全国生猪均价亦有同步企稳迹象。同时，川渝生猪养殖龙头企业巨星农牧的销售月报显示其7月的商品猪出栏量再度出现环比下降、出栏体重环比大降3.2公斤/头，涌益咨询数据显示四川的最新生猪出栏均重较7月初下降0.9公斤/头（降幅明显大于其他省）、肥标价差也有明显提升，或侧面反映川渝地区的生猪供给压力或已有明显缓解。

headlines.title_en: SDIC Securities: National hog prices expected to see a seasonal rebound in peak demand season
headlines.summary_en: Essence Securities research report says in low-priced regions, Sichuan-Chongqing leads gains, with recent pig prices firming. Since July 28, pig prices in Sichuan-Chongqing have stabilized and risen, with gains of 0.9 yuan/kg and 0.8 yuan/kg respectively as of August 6. The national average pig price also shows signs of stabilizing. Meanwhile, leading Sichuan-Chongqing pig farming firm CR Agriculture's monthly sales show commercial pig shipments fell month-over-month in July, with shipment weights down sharply by 3.2 kg/head; Yongyi Consulting data shows Sichuan's latest average pig shipment weight is down 0.9 kg/head from early July (a larger drop than other provinces), with the fat-lean price spread also widening, indirectly reflecting a notable easing of pig supply pressure in the region.

headlines.title: 美国7月CPI即将揭晓 美联储加息预期再迎考验
headlines.summary: 【美国7月CPI即将揭晓 美联储加息预期再迎考验】北京时间8月12日20时30分，美国劳工部将公布7月消费者价格指数（CPI）。市场预计，美国整体CPI和核心CPI同比增速均将继续回落，但环比增速可能由负转正。市场人士认为，就业降温降低了美联储加息的紧迫性，但美国失业率仍处于低位，能源价格和人工智能投资带来的通胀风险也未完全消退。相较于单月就业人数的变化，未来两份通胀报告以及美联储主席凯文·沃什的政策风格可能更直接影响美联储9月的政策选择。

headlines.title_en: US July CPI due soon; Fed rate hike expectations face another test
headlines.summary_en: [US July CPI due soon, Fed rate hike expectations face new test] At 20:30 Beijing time on August 12, the US Labor Department will release July CPI. The market expects both headline and core CPI year-over-year growth to continue easing, but month-over-month growth may turn positive from negative. Analysts say cooling employment reduces the urgency for Fed rate hikes, but the unemployment rate remains low, and inflation risks from energy prices and AI investment are not fully resolved. Compared with single-month employment changes, the next two inflation reports and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's policy style may more directly influence the Fed's September policy choice.
